#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;

    vector<int> c(3, 0);
    vector<vector<int>> pos(3);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int x = (s[i] == 'K') ? 0 : (s[i] == 'V') ? 1 : 2;
        pos[x].push_back(i);
        c[x]++;
    }

    // Initialize 4D DP array with large values
    vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(2,
        vector<vector<vector<int>>>(c[0] + 1,
            vector<vector<int>>(c[1] + 1,
                vector<int>(c[2] + 1, INT_MAX / 2)
            )
        )
    );

    dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

    for (int i0 = 0; i0 <= c[0]; ++i0) {
        for (int i1 = 0; i1 <= c[1]; ++i1) {
            for (int i2 = 0; i2 <= c[2]; ++i2) {
                for (int isLast1 = 0; isLast1 < 2; ++isLast1) {
                    int cur = dp[isLast1][i0][i1][i2];
                    if (cur >= INT_MAX / 2) continue;

                    // If last was 'K' (0), try to pick next 'K'
                    if (i0 < c[0] && isLast1 == 0) {
                        int swaps = 0, pos0 = pos[0][i0];
                        for (int i = i1; i < c[1]; ++i) {
                            if (pos[1][i] < pos0) swaps++;
                        }
                        for (int i = i2; i < c[2]; ++i) {
                            if (pos[2][i] < pos0) swaps++;
                        }
                        dp[0][i0 + 1][i1][i2] = min(dp[0][i0 + 1][i1][i2], cur + swaps);
                    }

                    // If next 'V' (1)
                    if (i1 < c[1]) {
                        int swaps = 0, pos1 = pos[1][i1];
                        for (int i = i0; i < c[0]; ++i) {
                            if (pos[0][i] < pos1) swaps++;
                        }
                        for (int i = i2; i < c[2]; ++i) {
                            if (pos[2][i] < pos1) swaps++;
                        }
                        dp[1][i0][i1 + 1][i2] = min(dp[1][i0][i1 + 1][i2], cur + swaps);
                    }

                    // If next 'L' (2)
                    if (i2 < c[2]) {
                        int swaps = 0, pos2 = pos[2][i2];
                        for (int i = i0; i < c[0]; ++i) {
                            if (pos[0][i] < pos2) swaps++;
                        }
                        for (int i = i1; i < c[1]; ++i) {
                            if (pos[1][i] < pos2) swaps++;
                        }
                        dp[0][i0][i1][i2 + 1] = min(dp[0][i0][i1][i2 + 1], cur + swaps);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int answer = min(dp[0][c[0]][c[1]][c[2]], dp[1][c[0]][c[1]][c[2]]);
    cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
